start.description: Start epoch or start date specified in the request.

end.description: End epoch or end date specified in the request.

page.description: The current page number sent in the request.

total.description: The total number of records resulted for the input criteria.

data.description: An array that contains stake account rewards.

accumulated_sol.description:
Accumulated rewards in SOL between the start and end specified in the request. Values will be displayed up to 9 decimal places

When "type" = "NET_BLOCK", net block rewards will be returned.

accumulated_lamports.description:
Accumulated rewards in lamports between the start and end specified in the request.

When "type" = "NET_BLOCK", net block rewards will be returned.

stake_account.description: The stake_account that received the rewards.

validator_address.description: Address of the validator that distributed the rewards (the validator the delegator is attached to).

total_sol.description:
Total rewards the delegator earned from inception in SOL. Values will be displayed up to 9 decimal places

Note: Block rewards will not be available from delegator inception, therefore this field will not consider block rewards. Only inflation rewards and MEV rewards will be considered.

total_lamports.description:
Total rewards the delegator earned from inception in lamports.

Note : Similar to "total_sol" this field will not consider block rewards

apy.description: The Annualized Percentage Yield of the stake account. This value is calculated considering net inflation and net MEV rewards earned during the last 10 completed epochs.

block_rewards_apy.description: The Annualized Percentage Yield on block rewards earned by the stake account. This value is calculated considering net block rewards earned during the last 10 completed epochs.

total_apy.description: The total Annualized Percentage Yield on all rewards attributable to the stake account in the last 10 epochs, after commissions and rebates.

total_accumulated_sol.description:
Total rewards the delegator has earned for the query criteria in SOL. Values will be displayed up to 9 decimal places

Update: Reflects the sum of MEV and inflation rewards only. Block rewards are excluded from this calculation.

total_accumulated_lamports.description:
Total rewards the delegator has earned for the query criteria in lamports.

Update: Reflects the sum of MEV and inflation rewards only. Block rewards are excluded from this calculation.

accumulated_gross_block_rewards_sol.description:
The total gross block rewards earned by the stake account for the query criteria in SOL.

Note: If the query covers epochs/dates prior to implementation of the block rewards calculation, block rewards will not be considered.

accumulated_gross_block_rewards_lamports.description:
The total gross block rewards earned by the stake account for the query criteria in lamports.

Note: If the query covers epochs/dates prior to implementation of the block rewards calculation, block rewards will not be considered.

accumulated_net_block_rewards_sol.description:
The net block rewards earned by the stake account for the query criteria in SOL, net of the staking platform commissions.

Note: If the query covers epochs/dates prior to implementation of the block rewards calculation, block rewards will not be considered.

accumulated_net_block_rewards_lamports.description:
The net block rewards earned by the stake account for the query criteria in lamports, net of the staking platform commissions.

Note: If the query covers epochs/dates prior to implementation of the block rewards calculation, block rewards will not be considered.

accumulated_rewards.description:
Protocol, MEV, and block rewards for the given delegator and query criteria. A new rewards type "NET_BLOCK" has been introduced.

Note: If the query covers epochs/dates prior to implementation of the block rewards calculation, block rewards will be set to 0.

epoch.description: The epoch corresponding to the rewards. This is applicable only if the rollup_type is 1

timestamp.description: If the rollup_type is 1, it should specify the timestamp corresponding to the end of the epoch.

balance.description: The balance of the account after rewards have been added.

total_epoch_sol.description:
Total rewards accumulated during the period in SOL. Values will be displayed up to 9 decimal places

Update: Reflects the sum of MEV and inflation rewards only. Block rewards are excluded from this calculation.

total_epoch_lamports.description:
Total rewards accumulated during the period in lamports.

Update: Reflects the sum of MEV and inflation rewards only. Block rewards are excluded from this calculation.

total_epoch_gross_block_rewards_sol.description: The gross block rewards earned by the stake account for the epoch, in SOL.

total_epoch_gross_block_rewards_lamports.description: The gross block rewards earned by the stake account for the epoch, in lamports.

total_epoch_net_block_rewards_sol.description: The net block rewards earned by the stake account for the epoch, in SOL, net of the staking platform commissions.

total_epoch_net_block_rewards_lamports.description: The net block rewards earned by the stake account for the epoch, in lamports, net of the staking platform commissions.

rewards.description: An array that contains protocol, mev, and block rewards corresponding to the given epoch. A new rewards type "NET_BLOCK" has been introduced.

rewards_sol.description:
Rewards accumulated during the period in SOL. Values will be displayed up to 9 decimal places

When "type" = "NET_BLOCK", net block rewards will be returned.

rewards_lamports.description:
Rewards accumulated during the period in lamports.

When "type" = "NET_BLOCK", net block rewards will be returned.
